result.title: Releasing the Inner Jev: A Simple Recipe for Open Decision Models
result.summary: LLM-based decision-making systems, also called System One models, have recently gained popularity, most notably through Jev (Almeida, 2026). Given a typed input state, a question, and a set of options, they return a probability for each option in a single forward pass, without text generation. We show that existing open instruction-tuned language models can achieve comparable performance \textit{without any additional training}, by reading out answers from letters (A, B, C, etc.) in the model's output logits at the last token position. Furthermore, we show how a simple supervised fine-tuning recipe can improve their performance further. We evaluate four open instruction-tuned language models: Gemma 4 31B, Gemma 4 12B, Qwen3.6-27B, and Qwen3.5-4B. We fine-tune each using LoRA and a decision head initialized from a slice of the language model head. Furthermore, we introduce OpenDecisions, a novel 2,352-question validation dataset designed to reflect the task composition of JevBench (JevBench main- tainers, 2026) and which computes a Capability score based on accuracy and calibration metrics. Without fine-tuning, Gemma 4 31B scores 79.6 on OpenDecisions, compared to Jev's 80.1. After undergoing our fine-tuning recipe, it scores 84.4 on OpenDecisions and 81.5 on JevBench v1.7, outperforming Jev by 4.3 and 4.4 Capability points respectively and setting a new state-of-the-art on OpenDecisions. On a suite of public decision datasets, our models achieve accuracy comparable to Jev, with lower calibration error. Our results show that open language models already possess System One capabilities, and with simple fine-tuning they outperform Jev on a wide range of decision tasks. We release our models, serving code, and OpenDecisions.

AI.brief_summary: 论文指出开源指令模型无需训练即可在单次前向中从末位 token 对应的选项字母 logits 读出答案，接近 Jev 这类「System One」决策模型，并用 LoRA 加由语言模型头切片初始化的决策头微调进一步提升，同时发布 2,352 题的 OpenDecisions 验证集。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「跳过文本生成、直接从末位 token 的 logits 或决策头读出答案」以及选项概率校准评价的做法，可能为 LVR 中从 latent 状态解码答案、评估候选置信度提供可核查线索；但论文纯文本、无视觉输入与 latent 推理，与主线联系较间接。
